question.text: A tetrapeptide " $x$ " on complete hydrolysis produced glycine (Gly), alanine (Ala), valine (Val), leucine (Leu) in equimolar proportion each. The number of tetrapeptides (sequences) possible involving each of these amino acids is

solution.text:
The number of tetrapeptides (sequences) possible involving each of these amino acids (glycine, alanine, valine, leucine) ; It has three (3) peptides linkage the number of permutations in which they can be arranged
$\begin{aligned}
& =4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1 \\
& =24
\end{aligned}$
